chart_world_scale.calibration_requirement: Match CHART native geometry atf2394 first. If native endpoint world scale is Sfinal, desiredworldscale=Sfinal*ratio. Parent compensation localCHARTscale=100*desiredworldscale/(Rig.scale[0]/100). Preserve existing parent position.
chart_world_scale.key_interpolation: Use linear interpolation for dense measured keys; source repeated frames are retained in per-frame data. Avoid applying repeated easy-ease to each sample.
